originalTitle: How Google’s new Pixel 11 phones compare to last year’s models
summary: Google just added four new phones to the Pixel family: the Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL, and the Pixel 11 Pro Fold. content: Google just added four new phones to the Pixel family: the Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL, and the Pixel 11 Pro Fold. They’re slightly more expensive than their predecessors, but they come with some notable upgrades, including improved cameras and a new Tensor G6 chip that should deliver faster performance. The phones also have new photography tools, like Magic Capture, along with improvements to Gemini Intelligence, expanded Live Translate capabilities, and the ability to use Circle to Search directly through the camera. To make deciding whether you’ll upgrade or hold onto your last-gen phone a little simpler, we’re focusing on comparing the specs of the 6.3-inch Pixel 11 and Pixel 10 models, as well as the 6.8-inch Pro XL models. If you’re curious about how the Pixel 11 Pro Fold compares to its predecessor (and to the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 series foldables), we’ve got a spec comparison right here. Before we get to the specs, here’s a breakdown of what’s new. They’re more expensive, but you get more storage The most obvious difference is that, like almost everything these days, they’re more expensive than before. The Pixel 11 starts at $899, $100 more than its predecessor, but Google has doubled the base storage to 256GB with 12GB of RAM. The Pixel 11 Pro starts at $1,099 — $100 more than the Pixel 10 Pro’s launch price — with the same 256GB of storage and 12GB of RAM, and is available with up to 1TB of storage and 16GB of RAM. Meanwhile, Google’s larger 6.8-inch Pixel 11 Pro XL starts at $1,299 and offers the same storage and RAM configurations as the Pro. Tensor G6 allows for even more AI features Both the Pixel 11 and Pro phones run on Google’s new Tensor G6 chip, which the company claims should improve performance by up to 25 percent compared to its predecessor. The new chip also powers a host of AI upgrades, including improvements to Gemini Intelligence, which Google says can now pull more context from supported apps to proactively surface useful information. There are also new voice-to-text tools that remove filler words and clean up formatting, while writing assistance can use what’s on your screen to help draft, rewrite, and refine messages. Live Translate is also available on videos, podcasts, and voice messages, and Circle to Search now works directly through the camera, letting you identify objects, translate text, or search your surroundings without snapping a photo first. The cameras get some notable upgrades inside and out There are a number of camera improvements, too, along with new photography and video features. On the hardware side, the Pixel 11 has a slimmer camera bar that sits flush when paired with one of Google’s phone cases. It can also zoom in farther than its predecessor, reaching up to 30x for photos, while the Pixel 11 Pro series gets an updated 1/1.3-inch 50-megapixel sensor for its main camera and a redesigned telephoto sensor that Google says captures 32 percent more light. The Pro can also zoom up to 120x and features a 42-megapixel selfie camera. The Pro should be quicker at shooting in the dark, too, with Google claiming its Instant Night Sight can capture photos up to 4.5 times faster. Google has made several software improvements as well. The new Magic Capture mode in the camera app automatically captures photos and videos to make them ready to share with a tap. Camera Looks let you create custom styles for photos, while the Pixel 11 Pro series can record stabilized video at up to 8K using Pro Stable Video with Video Boost. A new Creator Suite also features tools for trimming and rearranging clips, using a teleprompter while recording, and improving speech clarity, and it automatically saves clips to a designated project album. How the Pixel 10 and Pixel 11 compare Those are some of the biggest changes, but they’re far from the only differences between the two lineups. For example, both the Pixel 11 and Pixel 11 Pro offer an Extreme Charging Mode that prioritizes charging over other tasks for a faster boost when you’re short on time. The Pixel 11 Pro and Pro XL also gets HiLight, colored LEDs around the camera flash that can alert you to things, like calls when your phone is face down or when Gemini is activated. For a closer look at those changes and everything else that separates the Pixel 11 and Pixel 11 Pro from their predecessors, we’ve broken down the specs side by side below. chineseContent: 谷歌刚刚为 Pixel 系列添加了四款新手机：Pixel 11、Pixel 11 Pro、Pixel 11 Pro XL 和 Pixel 11 Pro Fold。它们比前代产品稍贵一些，但进行了一些显着的升级，包括改进的摄像头和可提供更快性能的新 Tensor G6 芯片。这些手机还配备了新的摄影工具，例如 Magic Capture，以及 Gemini Intelligence 的改进、扩展的实时翻译功能以及直接通过相机使用 Circle 进行搜索的功能。为了让您更简单地决定是升级还是保留上一代手机，我们重点比较 6.3 英寸 Pixel 11 和 Pixel 10 型号以及 6.8 英寸 Pro XL 型号的规格。如果您想知道 Pixel 11 Pro Fold 与其前身（以及三星 Galaxy Z Fold 8 系列可折叠手机）相比如何，我们在这里提供了规格比较。在了解规格之前，我们先对新功能进行详细介绍。它们更贵，但你可以获得更多的存储空间 最明显的区别是，就像现在的几乎所有东西一样，它们比以前更贵。 Pixel 11 起价为 899 美元，比前代产品贵了 100 美元，但谷歌将基本存储容量增加了一倍，达到 256GB，配备 12GB RAM。 Pixel 11 Pro 的起价为 1,099 美元，比 Pixel 10 Pro 的上市价格贵了 100 美元，同样配备 256GB 存储空间和 12GB RAM，最高可提供 1TB 存储空间和 16GB RAM。与此同时，谷歌更大的 6.8 英寸 Pixel 11 Pro XL 起价为 1,299 美元，并提供与 Pro 相同的存储和 RAM 配置。 Tensor G6 允许更多 AI 功能 Pixel 11 和 Pro 手机都运行谷歌全新的 Tensor G6 芯片，该公司声称该芯片与之前的产品相比，性能可提高高达 25%
